description: With the buyer's request, assess their leadership situation and return one fitting live resource with a direct Stan link, a Calendly booking link, or one clarifying question to continue inside this AI conversation; never sends messages or completes payment.

buyer_requested.description: True only when this buyer has asked for help choosing a resource or next step. False on refusal or absent consent.

preference.description: The buyer's stated preference. Use exploring if it is unknown; never infer a paid preference from their job title.

situation.description: The buyer's own leadership situation, without contact details or sensitive personal information.

name: get_buyer_next_step
title: Continue a buyer-requested leadership conversation
